title: A bandmate's seizure during a radio broadcast
summary: Bocage tells of a bandmate who had a convulsion during a remote broadcast at a Bourbon Street club.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians
